capabilities: Render brand icons inline from :brand:domain: syntax
Override icon variant and pixel size per use
Configure a brand icon provider, default size, and default variant
Add new icon providers via a BrandProvider interface
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installation is manual (copying files into .obsidian/plugins/brand-icons/).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display a company's brand logo inline within note text.
summary: Inline brand icon renderer that turns :brand:domain: codes in notes into company logos fetched from a configurable icon provider.
